Implemented the CLI simulator in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It accepts the requested flags, reads RS274 programs plus optional tool/parameter files, executes modal/state changes and motion, writes the final machine-state JSON, and writes trace JSON with time/distance/tolerance sampling when requested.

I verified it with `node --check` and a few smoke runs covering linear motion/tracing, `M2` reset behavior, tool-length offset validation, percent-delimited input, and canned-cycle trace transitions.

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
